set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=1eb81f1202a8a0b4aace6231c73656ef14920c3d; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; export GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; test -x "$GRADLE_BIN"; git fetch origin main agent-control; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/patches/local-speech-capability-probe.py > /tmp/local-speech-capability-probe.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/patches/local-speech-capability-api-guard-fix.py > /tmp/local-speech-capability-api-guard-fix.py; python3 /tmp/local-speech-capability-probe.py; python3 /tmp/local-speech-capability-api-guard-fix.py; bash scripts/verify_host.sh; echo host_quality_gate_green=true; git diff --check; git add app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/DiagnosticProbeActivity.kt app/src/main/kotlin/pl/michalmatu/aicallbridge/LocalSpeechCapabilityProbe.kt; git commit -m 'feat: add local speech capability probe'; git push origin HEAD:main; echo pushed_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD); test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; DEVICES=$(adb devices -l || true); PRESENT=$(DEVICES="$DEVICES" PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -c 'import os; from realtime_network_smoke import is_direct_usb_target; print(1 if is_direct_usb_target(os.environ.get("DEVICES", ""), "RFCT70L7E8J") else 0)'); if [ "$PRESENT" != 1 ]; then echo local_speech_direct_usb=false; echo local_speech_physical_probe_not_run=true; exit 0; fi; echo local_speech_direct_usb=true; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); echo local_speech_call_state=$CALL_STATE; if [ "$CALL_STATE" != 0 ]; then echo local_speech_idle_call_required=true; echo local_speech_physical_probe_not_run=true; exit 0; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/local-speech-install.log; cat /tmp/local-speech-install.log; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/local-speech-capability-report.txt 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_local_speech_capability_probe true; REPORT=''; for i in $(seq 1 40); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat files/local-speech-capability-report.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); if printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; then break; fi; sleep 0.5; done; echo '--- local speech capability report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo '--- end report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$'; echo local_speech_physical_probe_complete=true; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
